uncited: **Inputs:** A curvilinear grid mesh (defined by vertices and connectivity) and a scalar field defined at each vertex.
**Outputs:** A 2D image with color and opacity values.
The method requires data structures to track face rendering status to ensure each face is drawn exactly once.
**Identify Faces:** Determine the faces of each cell.
**Check Rendering Status:** For each face, check the data structures to see if it has already been rendered.
Draw the face as a Gouraud-shaded polygon.
The vertices of the polygon are the projected screen-space coordinates of the grid vertices.
**Composite:** The hardware compositing pipeline blends the drawn polygons.
**Time Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
**Memory Complexity:** Not given in the sources.
